about: Replay fixtures, test inputs and not results: the step rows the env wrote in two recorded episodes of the Munster wake task (munster1066-kingdom-30y-wake) (every step's metrics, rewards and end), reduced to what a judge reads (replay.recorded_rows). In the first the title is first held after a call of the seat's own turn, in the second after a standing order the seat left; test_once_goal.py re-judges both under the task they were written by and under the once task.
